cases.name: first page
cases.output: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY (SELECT NULL) OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 100 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: later page
cases.output: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY (SELECT NULL) OFFSET 150 ROWS FETCH NEXT 50 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: keeps a top-level ORDER BY

input.sql: SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY name

cases.output: SELECT id, name FROM users ORDER BY name OFFSET 20 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: lower-case order by across a line break

input.sql:
SELECT id FROM users order
  by id DESC

cases.output:
SELECT id FROM users order
  by id DESC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: ORDER BY after a UNION

input.sql: SELECT id FROM a UNION SELECT id FROM b ORDER BY id

cases.output: SELECT id FROM a UNION SELECT id FROM b ORDER BY id OFFSET 5 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: a column named like ORDER_BY is not ORDER BY
cases.output: SELECT order_by FROM t ORDER BY (SELECT NULL) OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: large numbers

input.sql: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id

cases.output: SELECT id FROM t ORDER BY id OFFSET 9007199254740991 ROWS FETCH NEXT 1000000 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: keeps a trailing semicolon
cases.output: SELECT 1; ORDER BY (SELECT NULL) OFFSET 5 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: ORDER BY inside OVER() (read as the query's)

input.sql: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at) AS rn FROM users

cases.output: SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at) AS rn FROM users OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: ORDER BY inside a subquery (read as the query's)

input.sql: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT TOP 5 user_id FROM orders ORDER BY total DESC)

cases.output: SELECT * FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT TOP 5 user_id FROM orders ORDER BY total DESC) OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: ORDER BY inside a CTE (read as the query's)

input.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM orders) SELECT * FROM r

cases.output: WITH r AS (SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY kind ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM orders) SELECT * FROM r OFFSET 50 ROWS FETCH NEXT 25 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: ORDER BY inside a string literal (read as the query's)

input.sql: SELECT * FROM notes WHERE body = N'sort: ORDER BY name'

cases.output: SELECT * FROM notes WHERE body = N'sort: ORDER BY name' OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: ORDER BY inside a bracketed name (read as the query's)
cases.output: SELECT [order by] FROM t OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

cases.name: ORDER BY inside a comment (read as the query's)

input.sql: SELECT id FROM t /* ORDER BY id */ WHERE id > 1

cases.output: SELECT id FROM t /* ORDER BY id */ WHERE id > 1 OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY
